items.title: After World War I, He Took A Job With A Parcel Delivery Company. He Bought Company Stock Every Year. He Retired From UPS In 1952 And Said He Never Made More Than $14,000 A Year. 39 Years Later Theodore Johnson’s Fortune Was An Estimated $70 Million
items.summary: Theodore Johnson built a fortune on a modest salary with one simple habit, but the same strategy has wrecked workers at Enron and Lehman. Here is what his story teaches, and the danger hidden inside it.
